posts.name: Closed Alpha 1
posts.intro: The first time players fought in The Great War. On Saturday 21 November our testers took the field in a France against Germany battle, and the server stayed open afterwards as a free-for-all so everyone could keep trying it out.

sections.title: The battle
items: France against Germany over Lorraine, Alsace, Nancy and Verdun, on the real map of 1914 Europe.
Your side is fixed when you first join. Capture and hold the objectives shown at the top of the screen, with the tickets and the clock.
When you fall you drop nothing: choose which of your side's regions to come back in, with your class's kit.
A red wall marks the edge of the battlefield.

sections.title: Soldiers
items: Pick a class when the battle starts, each with its own gun, kit and armour; press P to change class for your next respawn.
Stamina, running and bandages work like a soldier's should; the stamina bar shows while it refills.
Every gun tells you what it really does: its damage to the body and the head, its fire rate and magazine, and the round it takes.
Tanks, crewed by anyone on the field.

sections.title: The war map
items: Press K for the map: the whole front drawn from the real terrain, with the 1914 borders of every province.
Zoom from all of Europe down to a single region, search for any place, and see who holds what.

sections.title: Your game
items: Chat works for everyone, including players whose Minecraft account limits chat.
Your settings come with you to every new version of the pack, and the first launch is set up to run smoothly.
The website is ready to link your game to your Discord account and keep your settings online; the button in the game is coming next.
